payload.core_mechanism_summary: 1D DP array indexed by model index; dp[i] = max length ending at i; iterates i from 1..n, for each multiple j of i, updates dp[j] if s[i] < s[j].
payload.rationale: The solution uses a single array dp of size n, with state defined only by the current index, fitting the classic dp_1d_state pattern.
